name: Discountify – Discount Rules, BOGO & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Discountify lets you run a WooCommerce sale in a couple of minutes. You create a discount rule, choose who and what it applies to, set the dates, and save. The new price shows on the shop page, product page, cart and checkout automatically, with a sale badge you can style. Customers don’t need a coupon code.

Use it for Black Friday and seasonal sales, clearance events, “buy one get one free” offers, quantity discounts, cart offers or free shipping thresholds. Rules switch on and off on the dates you set.

Live demo · Documentation & Pro · Support

What you get for free

  • Discount rule builder. Create, enable, disable and manage as many discount rules as you need from one screen.
  • Sitewide (storewide) discounts. Put every product in the store on sale with one rule.
  • Category discounts. Discount whole product categories, such as 30% off all shoes.
  • Product discounts. Discount specific products you choose.
  • Percentage discounts. For example, 20% off everything.
  • Fixed amount discounts. For example, $5 off each product.
  • Cart discounts. Discount the order automatically when the cart meets conditions you set, such as a minimum total.
  • BOGO – Buy X Get X. Buy one get one free, buy one get one at a percentage off, or buy N get 1 free on the same product.
  • Bulk (quantity) pricing. Up to 3 quantity tiers per rule, such as 5+ items = 10% off and 10+ items = 15% off.
  • Free shipping discounts. Give free shipping based on cart amount, products or categories.
  • Simple and variable products. Discounts apply to every variation and show correctly in the mini cart.
  • Scheduled rules. Set a start and end date so a sale runs on its own.
  • Custom discount badges. Replace the default “Sale” badge with the amount saved, styled to match your theme.
  • Import and export rules. Move your discount setup between stores or keep a backup.
  • Block cart and checkout support. Works with the classic and block-based WooCommerce cart and checkout.

Discountify Pro

Discountify Pro adds advanced promotion types:

  • Buy X Get Y – buy one product, get a different product free or discounted
  • Category BOGO and BOGO fixed price
  • Free product / free gift with purchase
  • Unlimited bulk pricing tiers
  • Dynamic pricing that changes product prices across the shop, product page and cart
  • Conditional discounts based on cart, product and customer rules
  • Category combination discounts (for example, buy a shirt and get sunglasses discounted)
  • Discounts based on total spend and purchase history
  • Customer-specific pricing
  • First-order discounts

Who it’s for

  • Store owners who want to run a sale without creating and sharing coupon codes
  • Agencies setting up seasonal promotions for client stores
  • Shops that want a free shipping threshold or a cart discount to raise average order value

🔥 What’s next

If you like Discountify, try our other plugins:

  • MemberHub – Memberships for WordPress and WooCommerce
  • Filter Plus – WooCommerce product filter by price, rating, tags, custom fields and more
  • Quicker – Faster WooCommerce checkout and post-purchase upsells
  • Bens Email Marketing & Automation – Email marketing, newsletters, automation and CRM for WordPress
  • MenuBook – Restaurant reservations and set menu management for WordPress
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Discountify, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active. Discountify will ask you to install or activate it if it isn’t.

Create your first discount (about 60 seconds)

  1. Go to Discountify → Discount Rules and click Add Discount Rules.
  2. Choose a rule type, such as Sitewide Store Discount, and enter a percentage or fixed amount.
  3. Optionally set a start and end date, then click Save.
  4. Open your shop page. Discounted prices and the sale badge are already showing.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip and upload the discountify folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins screen.
sections.faq:
Do customers need a coupon code?

No. Discount rules apply automatically when their conditions are met, and the discounted price shows on the shop, product, cart and checkout pages.

How do I run a storewide sale in WooCommerce?

Go to Discountify → Discount Rules, click Add Discount Rules, choose “Sitewide Store Discount”, enter a percentage or fixed amount, and save. Add a start and end date if you want the sale to switch on and off by itself.

How do I set up Buy One Get One Free (BOGO)?

Go to Discountify → Discount Rules, click Add Discount Rules and choose “BOGO / Buy X Get X”. Pick BOGO Free, BOGO Percent Off or Buy N Get 1 Free, select the products, and save. The free item is added to the cart automatically. Buy X Get Y (a different product) is in Pro.

How do I add bulk or quantity discounts?

Choose the “Bulk / Quantity Discount” rule type and add up to 3 tiers, for example 5+ items = 10% off and 10+ items = 15% off. Pro removes the tier limit.

Can I discount a single category or specific products?

Yes, and it’s free. Choose the Category Discount or Product Discount rule type, pick the categories or products, and set the amount.

How do I add a cart discount?

Create a Cart Discount rule and set the cart conditions, such as a minimum cart total. When the cart meets them, the discount is applied automatically.

Can I offer free shipping above a certain order value?

Yes. The Free Shipping rule lets you give free shipping based on the cart amount, specific products or categories.

What is free and what is in Pro?

Sitewide, category, product, cart and free shipping discounts (percentage or fixed), BOGO on the same product (Buy X Get X), bulk pricing with up to 3 tiers, scheduling, badges and import/export are free. Buy X Get Y, category BOGO, free gifts, unlimited bulk tiers, total spend, dynamic pricing, conditional rules, purchase history and customer-specific pricing are in Discountify Pro.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block cart and checkout?

Yes. Discountify supports both the classic shortcode-based and the block-based cart and checkout.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Discounts apply to all variations, and the discounted price is shown in the cart and mini cart.

Will it work with my theme?

Discountify uses standard WooCommerce price hooks, so it works with well-coded WooCommerce themes. If something looks wrong with your theme, open a thread in the support forum and we’ll fix it.

Does it need any third-party service?

No. Everything runs inside your WordPress site.

I found a bug or need a feature. Where do I go?

Please post in the support forum. We read every thread and use them to decide what to build next.
